waivers.rationale: pk_core 100-item conformance gate not runnable: pk_core not bundled with this archive
waivers.compensating_controls: local suites (130+ tests) + RTM coverage; component.py still binds pk_core when present

waivers.rationale: No live OIDC discovery/JWKS refresh or token revocation list
waivers.compensating_controls: short token lifetime cap (max_lifetime_s=3600), optional single-use jti, static JWKS pinned per config generation

waivers.rationale: Adjacent layers exercised only against protocol-faithful stubs (INV-63, GAP-13); no IdP/registry/wasmCloud

waivers.compensating_controls: anchor key must be kept off the journal volume (RB-DAY0); verification uses an external trusted-key file

waivers.rationale: No transparency-log inclusion proofs; no live OCI registry digest resolution
waivers.compensating_controls: mandatory digest pinning + Ed25519 signature binding digest and name; resolver slot

waivers.rationale: Benchmarks from one cloud container; thresholds PROPOSED; no fleet-scale/scale-out runs
waivers.compensating_controls: perf gate enforces the contract SLO p99<50ms on every run

waivers.rationale: GitOps webhook authentication and commit-signature verification not built
waivers.compensating_controls: GitOps input gets no bypass: full admission incl. artifact signatures

waivers.rationale: No hash-pinned lock (PyPI unreachable from build env); container base image digest unpinned
waivers.compensating_controls: exact version pins in constraints.txt; wheel builds reproducibly (identical sha256 twice)

waivers.rationale: C068 edge power/thermal proposed NOT APPLICABLE (central plane)
